description: SL-I: adds another set of eight inputs to a Solim chain, processed on its own and paired with the matching SL-O output expander; it goes to the left of the Solim module

inputs.text: One of the voltages this expander feeds into the chain; an unpatched jack is skipped rather than read as 0V

notes: this expander is placed to the left of the Solim module; up to seven of them can be chained, and the lamp at the top turns green when the chain reaches this one
its eight values are limited and sorted separately from the main module's, using the same knobs, and they come out of the SL-O expander paired with it
a single polyphonic cable on one input is read as up to eight separate values; as soon as two inputs are patched, every input is read as its first channel only
with no matching SL-O expander in the chain, the values patched here are not processed at all
